english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a connection, an interpersonal relationship, or a romantic relationship when the context makes the meaning clear.
This is the all-purpose choice for a connection between things or a relationship between people, groups, or countries.
This is the all-purpose choice for a close, positive relationship, especially in phrases such as 維持良好關係.
Use this for a connection or bond between people or groups.

examples.english: My relationship with my new colleague is pretty good.
examples.traditional: 我同新同事嘅關係幾好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 gei2 hou2

examples.english: These two companies have a good relation.
examples.traditional: 呢兩間公司嘅關係幾好。

examples.english: We have maintained a good rapport, so working together has been smooth.
